name: T2 current-data old-response preservation for B with centered head learning
purpose: Frozen encoder improved centered old accuracy in all three seeds (+.6/.8/.6pp) while mean new loss was.9pp, satisfying the predeclared encoder-preserving branch. Test whether a fixed task-start response teacher can retain old responses while preserving useful B learning. This is one mainline mechanism experiment, not a claim of a new distillation method.
previous_result: Frozen T2 exact invariance qualified in all seeds; centered mean old+.6667pp/new-.9pp/overall-.1167pp versus adapting B. Remaining old restricted-to-allseen gaps1.1/2.3/3.1pp show new-head competition still exists. Original three-task BOTH gates remain failed.
scientific_change: B loss = unchanged current-class CE + mean squared error of centered old-head scale16 logits against a frozen task-start teacher, on exactly the same current-task augmented images. Mean covers batch and old classes. Coefficient fixed1.0, no temperature or coefficient sweep. Student classifier detached in the B path. Head uses unchanged centered-all-seen CE on detached student features; old head frozen. Teacher sees no old images/labels and receives no gradients.
teacher: Copy the exact shared T2 model into a frozen eval-mode teacher. Retain the task-start client model in memory; no extra teacher model transmission or disk duplicate is required in this simulator. Teacher is used during training only and discarded at inference; additional full encoder forward on every current image is charged. All teacher tensors must exactly match source at completion.
shared_start: Same source T2 model/state/RNG and physical GPU per seed as previous centered-loss/frozen runs; no control retraining. Primary comparison: adapting-encoder centered-loss T2; frozen-encoder T2 and original current-CE T2 reported as context.
fixed_training: T2 only; five rounds x five epochs,10clients,batch16,QVrank32,shared fixed A/originalSSB B/FedAvg/singlemerge; headAdamW.001wd0 reset/localGram/alpha.5 constrainedRegMean/rawFedAvg norms unchanged. FP32 deterministic mathSDPA/TF32off/CUBLAS=:4096:8. Inference bothraw andfixedcentered, centered is declared primary. No old training/replay, no test fitting.
qualification: CPU zero-start B/head gradient identity; after deterministic probe perturbation, preservation changes B gradient but not head gradient, teacher has no gradient, blockoffset invariance, full lifecycle/oldhead/teacherfreeze. Real preflight repeats zero-start identity and deterministic Bv perturbation1e-3*sin(index), no optimizer steps; actual first batch must match zero-start preflight with zero penalty. End50clients125000visits5certs, merge/history2,24Bzero,teacher exactsource/oldheadexact,positive preservation loss observed after start,student backbone actuallychanged, fullraw+centeredconfusionreload/source size+mtimeunchanged.

evaluation: All seeds raw/centered T2 overall/old/new/restricted/forgetting/error-transfer and paired deltas versus adapting, frozen and current controls. Report training preservation MSE and extra teacher compute/memory. The current-data teacher does not guarantee old-distribution invariance; actual old-task metrics decide. Shared test development evidence, no independent heldout claim.

gate.primary: Against adapting centered-loss T2 with fixed centered inference: mean old gain>=.5pp, mean new change>=-.5pp, mean overall gain>=.25pp, and each seed old change>=0pp (numerical tolerance1e-9). All integrity gates must pass.
gate.decision: If all pass, freeze this candidate and consider T3 continuation from these saved T2 endpoints under a new budgeted protocol, then evaluate BOTH unchanged original three-task gates before any full10. If any fail, retain negative/mixed result and choose a distinct evidence-based mechanism; no coefficient sweep, automatic costly retry, or weakened old gate.
